description.narrative: Naripokkho is a member-led women's rights organization in Bangladesh founded in 1983 with the commitment to resisting violence and discrimination against women and girls and advancing sexual and reproductive health and rights, in connection with their additional thematic work promoting political participation, community peacebuilding and economic justice. Their work is strongly volunteer-based and organized by consensus, particularly leveraging young women's leadership - young women activists, sex workers, garment workers, and women with diverse experiences of violence - to pursue advocacy campaigning against sexual violence, policy dialogue and movement-building. The grant will support the following specific priorities and activities: 1. Strengthen organization to develop, review and update strategic plan and policies 2. Strengthen the capacity of women, victims of violence, their families, youths, individuals and social institutions to respond and fight violence against women. 3. Working closely and doing advocacy with government and community initiatives for the prevention and reduction of violence against women.
